executionAuthority: Root/coordinator owns native execution; browser and visual execution were not authorized for this leaf.
sharedGates: Same actual native-window multi-Profile Space selection with real storage/authentication isolation.
Live saved-page handoff preserving TabModel/WebContents/controller/document identity; no clone or Model::OpenItem proxy pass.
Real target resolution, private/download classifiers, failure/cancellation handling and existing lifecycle/metadata codec remain authoritative.
Unavailable routes stay unavailable. Inspection of a source symbol does not prove a compiled/exposed native action.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Preview and open an owner-authorized legacy HTML note locally; export without an Arcified account; new-document routing uses the explicitly selected destination.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Unsupported/malformed or missing shared content is identified without executing imported script or changing originals; no fake native editor or remote recovery.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Open and close the actual reading surface from a real selected native page; verify keyboard focus, accessible names and return to the same page/Profile.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Exercise an unsupported document and private/download-classified content through the existing classifier. Preserve the original page; no blank or falsely successful reader surface.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Invoke an explicit paste/navigation action with a synthetic URL; verify native validation, selected page and real Profile/window target.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Cancel paste/navigation and exercise an invalid/disallowed URL. No background clipboard reads, unintended tab creation or navigation after cancellation.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Use active-tab status, recent switcher and ordered traversal by keyboard and accessibility tooling with multiple Spaces/windows.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Switch to a saved page already live elsewhere through the actual handoff path without duplicate/reload. No status indicator may falsely imply a different page is active.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Discover a supported verb and keyboard hint, invoke it through the real ActionItem target and dismiss help back to the initiating control.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: An unavailable legacy command stays unavailable; changing Profile/Space while help or the command bar is open must not dispatch a stale target.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Without provider access, navigate an ordinary GitHub bookmark/folder. If separately approved, exercise the actual Live Folder with named Profile/provider scope.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Disabled, logged-out, revoked, offline and stale states must be explicit. Imported metadata never silently authenticates or discovers an account.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Use local import/export, Profile organization and session recovery while no Arcified account or sync service is configured.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: No iCloud enrollment, new sync backend, remote conflict repair or mandatory account gate. Native settings/onboarding must accurately describe exclusion.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Under the Boost leaf's approved scope, apply and revert a declarative style/zap in the actual page and inspect persistence and disable controls.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Leave imported executable content inert. Unsupported legacy data, origin mismatch and disable/revert failures are visible without claiming full compatibility.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Use ordinary native local find without a provider or page-content upload.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: The retired/later AI route remains unavailable unless separate consent and provider work is accepted. No ask-page success screen backed by ordinary find.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Preview an authorized observed export, report supported/unmapped fields, then import through the existing codec into the explicitly chosen local target; re-export without an account.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Keep originals; malformed/unknown formats, absent hosted content and Profile ambiguity remain unresolved or reported. No inferred conversion of live page credentials or automatic source removal.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Open the site's own profile page or ordinary bookmark.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: No enrichment calls, person matching or fabricated card. Historical feature help must not advertise a service as available.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Open Notion, Figma and Linear ordinary favorites independently. Any later accepted per-site preview needs its own exact data/action scenario.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: No undocumented recent-document requests or actions. Disabled/offline/stale or unavailable previews must not present cached data as current; generic folder previews do not pass.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Confirm retirement documentation shows both conflicting primary references and ordinary local history remains independently usable.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: No passive personal-summary collection or proof-of-deletion claim. Installed Dia state is an external research check requiring later authorization, not a native Arcified pass.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Confirm desktop scope/help distinguishes iOS and Android references; inspect only an authorized provided link export through import-format work.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: No desktop parity claim for mobile-only AI/gestures, no sync enrollment, and no claim a link list contains complete session or Profile data.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Navigate ordinary work websites without a connector; desktop scope/help accurately marks connectors/decks/Morning Brief as deferred.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: No automatic authentication, connected-tool calls, generated deck/report or background briefing is implied by ordinary site support.

scenarios.requiredSuccess: Open an actually present local export or ordinary link while accurately identifying unavailable hosted functionality.
scenarios.requiredFailureOrUnsupported: Missing/expired/disabled vendor content stays unavailable. No fake store/service success, account creation, remote data-recovery promise or replacement sync backend.
